items.note: The consensus prize of the 2026 class — elite pace, elite hands, drives play every shift.

items.note: High-end dual-threat center; the engine of Chicago's rebuild.

items.note: Slick playmaking pivot — Boston's best center prospect in a generation.

items.note: Big-bodied winger with soft hands; pro frame already.

items.note: Heavy shot, pro habits, thrives against men in Sweden.

items.note: 6'5" center with skill to burn — health is the only question.

items.note: Two-way center who wins every layer of the ice.

items.name: Victor Eklund
items.note: Relentless motor; plays bigger than his frame every night.

items.note: 6'6" right shot who moves like a mid-sized defenseman.
